verdict.rationale: Expensify documents its own conversational AI ('Ask Expensify AI anything'). It can approve or reject expenses, build workspace rules, and answer questions about account data in plain language, which touches policy administration. However, no evidence shows the assistant enforcing policy toward the spender. Missing for 10: proactively chasing missing receipts, explaining declines to the submitter, answering 'can I expense this?' before spend happens, and independent or hands-on corroboration of the AI's policy behavior.
